import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const url = 'http://localhost:4173/'
const b = await chromium.launch()
const errs = []
async function shot(w, h, name, fn) {
  const p = await b.newPage({ viewport: { width: w, height: h }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 })
  p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errs.push(name + ': ' + m.text()) })
  p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(name + ': ' + e.message))
  p.on('requestfailed', r => errs.push(name + ' REQFAIL: ' + r.url()))
  await p.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await p.evaluate(async () => {
    await new Promise(r => { let y = 0; const t = setInterval(() => { y += 500; window.scrollTo(0, y); if (y > document.body.scrollHeight) { clearInterval(t); r() } }, 60) })
  })
  await p.waitForTimeout(500)
  if (fn) await fn(p)
  await p.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0))
  await p.waitForTimeout(400)
  const ow = await p.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth)
  console.log(name, 'scrollWidth', ow, 'viewport', w)
  await p.screenshot({ path: `/tmp/shots/${name}.png`, fullPage: true })
  await p.close()
}
await shot(1440, 900, 'desktop')
await shot(390, 844, 'mobile')
console.log('ERRORS:', errs.length ? errs : 'none')
await b.close()

import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const b = await chromium.launch()
const errs = []
// desktop: choose a finish, fill the form, submit
const p = await b.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } })
p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push('PE ' + e.message))
p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errs.push('CE ' + m.text()) })
await p.goto('http://localhost:4173/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await p.evaluate(async () => { await new Promise(r => { let y = 0; const t = setInterval(() => { y += 400; window.scrollTo(0, y); if (y > document.body.scrollHeight) { clearInterval(t); r() } }, 40) }) })

await p.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('path').scrollIntoView())
await p.waitForTimeout(500)
await p.locator('[data-stage="escapement"] .stage-hit').click()
await p.waitForTimeout(600)
console.log('focus attr:', await p.locator('#path .plate').getAttribute('data-focus'))
await p.locator('#path').screenshot({ path: '.shots/i-path-focus.png' })
// layers hover
await p.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('layers').scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }))
await p.waitForTimeout(600)
await p.locator('.scale-bars button').nth(1).hover()
await p.waitForTimeout(600)
await p.locator('#layers').screenshot({ path: '.shots/i-layers-hold.png' })
// choose finish + submit
await p.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('finishes').scrollIntoView())
await p.waitForTimeout(400)
await p.locator('[data-config="skeleton"] button').click()
console.log('topbar:', (await p.locator('.allocation').innerText()).replace(/\n/g, ' '))
await p.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('reserve').scrollIntoView())
await p.waitForTimeout(400)
